answers.Q1: Five fixed listening stations were visited, labeled S-1 through S-5.
answers.Q2: On the evening with the most call events, the eastern sedge zone wind speed was 1.4 m/s.
answers.Q3: The audio was captured with a Zoom H5 Handy Recorder.
answers.Q4: The observer recorded for five minutes at each station.
answers.Q5: One station, S-3, had an interrupted interval.
answers.Q6: Six call-distinct individual frogs accounted for the 42 call events in the eastern sedge zone.
